validation.experiment: Build a fixture-backed demo for Email/PDF/Excel -> validated draft order -> exception queue, then test it against five active buyer briefs.
validation.pass_condition: At least one buyer requests a paid pilot or technical interview after seeing the working demo.
validation.kill_condition: No paid-pilot/interview signal after 20 well-matched buyer briefs, or the demo requires bespoke integration work that destroys repeatability.

signals.note: $6,000 fixed-price brief for Email/PDF/Excel/WhatsApp -> AI extraction -> ERP sales-order automation.
$600 MVP brief for inbox ingestion, AI PDF parsing, database logging, and standardized order export.
$300 brief for multi-source order intake, validation, approvals, follow-up, and audit trail.
Shopify merchant reports replacing six years of manual B2B order entry; 100+ item PDF order processed in under four minutes.
Recent brief to eliminate repetitive post-order data entry across Shopify, Etsy, Square, Sheets, ShipStation, and Gmail.

validation.experiment: Build a vendor-neutral heartbeat/error/consistency checker for Shopify+n8n/Flow-style workflows using simulated failures, then show a hosted demo to active automation buyers.
validation.pass_condition: At least two prospects explicitly value monitoring/recovery as a standalone paid feature, or one agrees to a paid pilot.
validation.kill_condition: Buyers consistently treat reliability monitoring as a free implementation detail and will not pay separately.

signals.note: Buyer cites inconsistent executions, API failures, sync issues, and lack of monitoring/error recovery.
Active long-term $20-$25/hr role from a client with substantial historical spend for automation troubleshooting and operations.
Recent brief explicitly requests monitoring and failure alerts for e-commerce data sync.
Merchant asks for alerts when Shopify Flow workflows silently fail or do not run.

validation.experiment: Run a no-money shadow maker on fee-enabled Polymarket books and estimate fills, spread PnL, adverse selection, maker rebates, liquidity rewards, and inventory exposure.
validation.pass_condition: Positive net simulated PnL after conservative fill assumptions across multiple market regimes, with rewards not accounting for all profitability.
validation.kill_condition: PnL is negative after adverse selection/slippage assumptions, or profitability disappears without transient subsidies.

signals.note: Polymarket pays daily USDC maker rebates funded by taker fees in eligible markets.
Separate daily liquidity-reward program pays qualifying resting limit orders.

validation.experiment: Benchmark an agent on previously disclosed vulnerabilities with the answers hidden; measure recall, false positives, compute cost, and review time before touching any live in-scope target.
validation.pass_condition: Agent rediscovers a meaningful share of known high/critical issues with a low enough false-positive burden to justify authorized live testing.
validation.kill_condition: Recall remains low or human review cost dominates after iterative prompting/tooling.

signals.note: Immunefi reports $107.3M paid for confirmed critical vulnerabilities and a $20,000 median critical bounty.
Immunefi lists 174 live bounty programs as of Sep 20, 2026.
0x program advertises up to $1,000,000 for qualifying critical smart-contract bugs.
Sky reports $703.2k total paid across 19 reports, showing realized payouts rather than only posted maxima.

validation.experiment: Collect recent launch cohorts first; estimate organic creator-fee distributions at 30m/2h/24h/7d before issuing any batch of tokens.
validation.pass_condition: Observed creator-fee distribution remains attractive after launch costs, near-zero launches, and top-1% concentration are included.
validation.kill_condition: Median/expected net creator revenue is negative or almost all economics come from a tiny unreproducible tail.

signals.note: Bags states creators earn 1% royalties of all trading volume of a launched coin, before optional splits.
Pump pays creator fees on trades; current schedule starts at 0.30% on bonding curves and varies after graduation.
